# Mbed TLS 3.6.8

The `include` and `library` folders of [Mbed TLS](https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls) 3.6.8, the long-term support release of
16 November 2026, unmodified (`mbedtls-3.6.8.tar.bz2`, SHA-256
`bc54b818e87f49c0b3281dd85d24adaede0e63b4e822e3fbd49c005a38b9595b`). What is compiled is chosen in `net/tls/nexgen_tls_config.h`.
